details: Collaborated in a **3-person team** to design and build an autonomous sentry system according to design specifications simulating a Ministry of Defence security contract.
Developed Python software to process data from the sentry’s infrared sensors to enable real-time object detection and autonomous movement.
Applied Agile methodology to iteratively implement, test and improve the functionality of the sentry system.

Pitched the completed system to Leonardo engineers as a security contract bid, explaining design choices and demonstrating the function of the system within a test track achieving a **3rd place ranking across Leonardo UK branches.**
